services.name: Sunset Evening Paddle
services.desc: If you’re looking for a memorable way to end your day, join us for the Rio trip at sunset. This is the same route but a totally different feel. Grab your friends to do a trip that’s unlike anywhere else! Start your day with a peaceful paddle along a charming 5-mile stretch of river. At a relaxed pace (about 2-3 hours), you’ll have plenty of time to stop and swim, spread out a picnic, or just drift and enjoy the quiet. It’s the perfect easy morning on the water. We are on the beach next to the bridge and across the street from Veterans Memorial Beach. Photo credit belongs to the incredible Ron Keeley for all wildlife photos on our website and social media

services.name: The Alex Trip - Alexander Valley to Healdsburg
services.desc: Your exploration of the wilder upper section of the Russian River begins at the campground of our friends at Wildhaven Sonoma Glamping, just upstream in Healdsburg’s famous Alexander Valley. Their location provides access to a beautiful section of the river few get to see, as it’s the only launching spot in a 17-mile stretch of the river and is typically reserved for Wildhaven guests. This area has pristine waters, narrower passageways, and a wilder feeling. The wildlife is more on display here, including lots of fish and frequent sightings of otter families, ospreys, deer, turtles, and the occasional bald eagle.
